rights_note: A book printed in the United States in 1910, in the public domain; the Library of Congress states it is unaware of any copyright restrictions on the item. Texture derivation reviewed for this personal-photo preview; the public-domain original is the basis, not an unrelated face dataset.
access_notes: Found 2026-11-06 (T-3413) through the Internet Archive record of the book, which the Library of Congress catalogues under Glessner; the plate was read at the scan's 3000-pixel page image (leaf95_w3000.jpg).
note: A head-and-shoulders photograph of Glessner turned about a quarter towards his left, in round wire spectacles, a full grey moustache, a dark coat and tie with a wing collar; the crown of his head is bald with white hair at the sides. The photograph is undated: he was 67 when the book was printed. Crop of the preserved original scan; original crop coordinates remain in the existing portrait record. Ink dots are softened before downsampling, without generating facial detail. Monochrome intensity supplies detail; skin, iris, hair and clothing colours are reconstructed. The photograph does not attest hidden profile depth or exact appearance in another year.
what_it_supplies: the proportions of Glessner's face (eyes, nose, mouth, chin and ear) as one photograph shows them
that he wore spectacles and a moustache in the photograph
what_it_does_not_supply: the date the photograph was taken
his face's depth (one view only), its colour, or his height and build below the shoulders
